note: Fact writes only. Three last_checked stamps where a check happened and found nothing moved, one product rename Google made on 16 July 2026 carried across both tabs that name it, and four dead or stale URLs replaced with verified live ones. No verdict, DPIA flag, trustee note, jobs or description is touched. Undo with: node scripts/sheet-write.mjs reports/2026-08-31-axis-diff.json --rollback --commit

edits.name: Canva
edits.why: Canva's privacy policy republished 25 Aug, one day after the stored check. Diffed the superseded version (archived, itself dated 15 Apr 2026) against the live one: the data-location clause and the training clause are word for word identical. H=US and I=Varies by tier both stand. The stamp records a check that found nothing.
